documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Engineering Onboarding Guide
documents.short_summary: Engineering onboarding: 4-day bootcamp, first-week checklist (SSO, nimbus-core monorepo, buddy), architecture tour (Skyhook, Prism, Gatekeeper, helios-db), trunk-based dev with Friday deploy freeze, 30-60-90 expectations.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Information Security Policy v3
documents.short_summary: Security policy v3: SSO with hardware keys, production access only via Gatekeeper (recorded sessions), quarterly access reviews, 24h offboarding revocation, data classification, 13-month customer data retention, 24h incident reporting.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — On-Call Runbook v1
documents.short_summary: STALE. Legacy on-call: PagerBot paging with 15-min acknowledgement, Monday handoffs, manual helios-db failover (45-min RTO), no severity matrix or incident commander. Superseded by Runbook v2 (April 2024).

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — On-Call Runbook v2
documents.short_summary: Current on-call runbook: Opsgenie rotations, SEV1-4 severity matrix (SEV1 ack in 5 min), incident-commander role, Wednesday handoffs, AUTOMATED helios-db failover with 8-minute RTO. Written after the March 2024 outage.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Postmortem: helios-db Outage (March 4, 2024)
documents.short_summary: Blameless postmortem PM-2024-03: 3h42m helios-db outage, root cause a schema migration lock exhausting the pgbouncer pool; 38% of customers affected, $214K SLA credits; action items delivered automated failover and Runbook v2.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Performance Review Guide FY2024
documents.short_summary: FY2024 review guide: April/October cycles, 5-level rating scale with 10/25/50/10/5 calibration guidance, peer feedback (3-5 peers), promotion windows; comp adjustments follow the manager-level compensation bands.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Engineering Compensation Bands 2023
documents.short_summary: STALE. 2023 bands: L3 $118-142K, L4 $145-172K, L5 $178-205K; 8% bonus target; ad hoc equity refreshes; single national band with no geographic tiers. Superseded by the 2024 bands.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Engineering Compensation Bands 2024
documents.short_summary: Current 2024 bands (tier 1): L3 $128-152K, L4 $158-186K, L5 $192-224K; bonus target raised to 10%; annual equity refresh program; three geographic tiers (100%/92%/85%). Supersedes the 2023 bands.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Hiring Plan FY2025
documents.short_summary: FY2025 hiring plan: 24 net-new heads (11 eng incl. 2 SRE tied to the outage reliability program, 6 sales, 4 CS, 3 G&A), marketing backfills frozen, $380K recruiting budget, agency usage capped at 20%, AE hiring gated on Q2 ARR.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — SOC 2 Type II Audit Summary (2024)
documents.short_summary: SOC 2 Type II (Jun 2023-Mar 2024, Hartley & Voss): zero major exceptions; two minor findings — offboarding revocation latency and a Prism log-retention gap — both remediated by Q3 FY2025. Next window opens July 2024.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Board Deck Q1 FY2025 (Summary)
documents.short_summary: Q1 FY2025 board summary: ARR $22.4M (+31% YoY), NRR 112%, gross margin 74%, 1.1% monthly churn, 26-month runway, 640 customers; enterprise tier at 34% of new bookings; risks: usage-based pricing pressure, residency-blocked deals.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Project Alpine: Workforce Contingency Memo
documents.short_summary: EXEC-ONLY contingency memo: if Q2 net-new ARR misses plan by >25%, decision gate July 15 on a ~9% reduction (~16 roles) concentrated in marketing/G&A; 8 weeks + 2/yr severance standards. Not approved — contingency only.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Product Roadmap FY2025 Draft v0.4
documents.short_summary: STALE. Draft roadmap v0.4: AI assistant ('Copilot for dashboards') in Q2, warehouse-native Q3, EU residency Q4, mobile session replay deprioritized. Superseded by the final roadmap which resequenced all three bets.

documents.title: Nimbus Analytics — Product Roadmap FY2025 (Final)
documents.short_summary: Final FY2025 roadmap: EU data residency pulled forward to Q3 ($640K contingent ACV), Nimbus IQ (renamed AI assistant) beta Q3, warehouse-native mode moved to Q4, mobile session replay cut. Supersedes draft v0.4.
